page.overview:
Who is Heli-Viper?

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;"

!style="border:1px solid black" colspan=2|Generation 1

Heli-Vipers were introduced in 1992 as part of the Air Commandos subset of A Real American Hero toys. ---- Appearance: purple helmet with red goggles and face mask; purple shirt with red straps and light purple gloves; purple pants with red belt and knife; light purple padding.

Accessories: purple "'89 Night-Viper" rifle. ---- [http://www.yojoe.com/action/92/heliviper.shtml YoJoe.com page]/[http://www.yojoe.com/filecard/92/heliviper.shtml Filecard]
